fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor inlined in the fighter boma builder (g0042, near 0x710068a8e8) stores vptr 0x7104f72568 and stores the module at boma+0xF8. Only one class uses this vtable.

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Constructor stores the BattleObjectModuleAccessor beside the vptr; the event-registration slot (+0x28) and the reflect event handler reach the boma's +0x18 (event manager), +0x90 and +0xD8 modules through it.

fields.name: object_id
fields.evidence: object_id slot (+0x58) returns it; set_object_id (+0x60) stores it. Initial 0x50000000 (invalid battle object id). Reset to 0x50000000 by reset_info (+0x50) and by the unexported clear slot +0x48. The reflect event handlers store the reflector's battle object id here. is_reflect (+0xA8) = (this field != 0x50000000).

fields.name: team_no
fields.evidence: team_no (+0x68) returns it, set_team_no (+0x70) stores it. Initial -1. Reflect event handler writes the reflector's team number (its ReflectorModule get_team_no, vtable +0x150).

fields.name: attack_mul
fields.evidence: attack_mul (+0x78) loads it into s0, set_attack_mul (+0x80) stores s0. Initial 1.0, reset_info sets 1.0. Reflect event handler multiplies it by a factor obtained from the reflecting object (a manager call with the reflector's id).

fields.name: speed_mul
fields.evidence: speed_mul (+0x88) / set_speed_mul (+0x90). Initial 1.0, reset_info 1.0. On reflect replaced by the reflector's ReflectorModule get_speed_mul (vtable +0x100) unless no_speed_mul (+0x31) is set.

fields.name: life_mul
fields.evidence: life_mul (+0x98) / set_life_mul (+0xA0). Initial 0.0 and reset_info writes 0.0 (no multiplier until a reflect). On reflect set from the reflector's ReflectorModule get_life_mul (vtable +0x110).

fields.name: count
fields.evidence: count (+0xC0) returns it. Unexported slot +0xC8 increments it, +0xD0 zeroes it; both reflect event handlers increment it after a reflect. reset_info zeroes it. is_count_max (+0xB8) returns count >= common param reflect_count_max (hash40 0x11abe7673c, read through the global param manager).

fields.name: reverse_lr
fields.evidence: get_reverse_lr (+0xD8) loads it as a float. Initial 1.0, reset_info 1.0; the reflect event handler negates it on every reflect (so +1/-1 tells whether the projectile's direction is flipped).

fields.name: collision_no
fields.evidence: set_collision_no (+0xE0) stores its int. Initial -1. The reflect event handler only filters on the event's collision index when this is >= 0.

fields.name: flag_0x30 (reflected/hit marker)
fields.evidence: Unexported pair: slot +0xE8 returns this byte, slot +0xF0 stores arg&1. Cleared by the constructor and by the clear slot +0x48 (which also invalidates object_id). Not touched by reset_info.

fields.name: no_speed_mul
fields.evidence: set_no_speed_mul (export calls slot +0xB0, f_71004bdd90) stores arg&1. reset_info clears it. The reflect event handler skips overwriting speed_mul when set.

fields.name: listen_second_event
fields.evidence: Set from the bool arg of the initialisation slot +0x28 (f_71004bd960), which registers a reflect event listener (kind 2) and, when this is set, a second listener (kind 0xE, handler f_71004be4f0). The unregistration slot +0x30 removes the second listener only when this byte is set.

notes: Fighter (and all other objects) use one class, 0x7104f72568, 56 bytes (0x33..0x37 padding). The module is the reflected projectile's side: the event handler (f_71004bde70) runs when the object gets reflected, reads the reflector's ReflectorModule (other boma +0x108: get_attack_limit +0x120, get_attack_mul +0xF0, get_speed_mul +0x100, get_life_mul +0x110, get_team_no +0x150) and copies owner/team/multipliers here, negates reverse_lr and increments count. If is_count_max is true the reflect is refused. reset_info (+0x50) restores object_id 0x50000000, attack_mul 1, speed_mul 1, life_mul 0, count 0, reverse_lr 1, no_speed_mul 0.
